notes: Chunk 103 reviewed from saved Common Crawl text captures only. Three program-list pages: the MIT Sloan recent academic placements page (2017-2021, by research group; this capture has no Operations Management group, so it is useful for the non-OM areas and for later area classification), the Paris 1 EDMPS list of theses defended 2020-2021 (names, supervisors, titles; mixed management areas including supply chain and finance; no placements), and Richard de Neufville's personal advisee page (Engineering Systems Division dissertations 2015-2017 with department and role, also Harvard and Campinas theses he read and a separate master's theses section; a professor's page rather than a program page, so the integrator should decide whether to keep it). One single-record page (Ed Roberts, MIT PhD 1962, podcast transcript). All Luxembourg candidates are hosted by uni.lu but belong to the history centre, a physics initiative and the humanities faculty, not the logistics centre; institutions were left as given. The IIT Madras pages are electrical engineering admissions lists, not graduates. Several candidates are spam or unrelated (essay-mill forum post, bootcamp ad, gifted-education placement).
